Game Overview

CraneItUp is a tap game built around help a little girl retrieve her beloved bear toys from a claw machine filled with zombies. Precision and speed are your allies as you navigate the frantic countdown. Carefully aim and grab the right toys in this charming blend of skill and strategy, capturing hearts with its delightful challenge.
